description: This file defines the SignatureV4 class implementing AWS Signature Version 4 signing and presigning for HTTP requests, including handling for signature creation, request signing, presigning URLs, and integration with AWS CRT extensions.

classes.name: SignatureV4
classes.description: Implements AWS Signature Version 4 signing process, including request signing, presigning, and auxiliary methods for header management, canonicalization, and request transformation.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request with AWS Signature Version 4 using provided credentials and optional signing service.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for temporary access to an AWS resource using Signature Version 4.

methods.name: convertPostToGet
methods.description: Converts a POST request to a GET request by moving POST body parameters into the query string for presigning.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Calculates the payload hash or returns an unsigned indicator based on configuration.

methods.name: getPresignedPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the payload to be used for presigning.

methods.name: createCanonicalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a canonicalized URL path with double encoding.

methods.name: createStringToSign
methods.description: Constructs the string to sign based on request details and timestamp.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Prepares the request for presigning by handling security tokens and moving headers to query parameters.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Generates the canonical request string and signed headers list for signing.

methods.name: getCanonicalizedQuery
methods.description: Builds a canonical query string from request query parameters.

methods.name: convertToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts various date representations to a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: convertExpires
methods.description: Calculates expiration duration for presigned URLs, ensuring maximum allowed duration.

methods.name: moveHeadersToQuery
methods.description: Moves certain headers (like AWS-specific headers) into the query string for signing.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses a PSR-7 request into a structured array with method, path, headers, query, body, and version.

methods.name: buildRequest
methods.description: Builds a PSR-7 request object from parsed request data.

methods.name: verifyCRTLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the AWS CRT extension is loaded and throws if not.

methods.name: createCRTStaticCredentialsProvider
methods.description: Creates a static credentials provider for CRT signing.

methods.name: removeIllegalV4aHeaders
methods.description: Removes headers that are illegal or problematic for V4a signing and stores them to restore later.

methods.name: CRTRequestFromGuzzleRequest
methods.description: Converts a Guzzle PSR-7 request into an AWS CRT Request object.

methods.name: signWithV4a
methods.description: Signs a request using AWS CRT's V4a signing process.

methods.name: presignWithV4a
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL using AWS CRT's V4a signing process.
